item.title: Bulletin updated at 00:00 HKT 24/Apr/2023
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
A broad band of clouds will cover Guangdong today and tomorrow and bring showery weather to the region. A surge of the northeast monsoon is expected to affect the coastal areas midweek this week, it will be windier over the region. With the monsoon moderating in the latter part of this week, temperatures over the coast of Guangdong will rise gradually.

Weather: Mainly cloudy with one or two showers. Visibility relatively low in some areas in the morning and at night.
Temp range: 22 - 26 C
R.H. range: 80 - 95 per Cent
PSR: Low
